Another viral story based on bad intelligence. If you want journalism that's
written for you rather than clicks or awards, please become a paid subscriber
(or chip in to my [GoFundMe here](https://www.gofundme.com/f/bcatm9-testing).)

U.S. intelligence never concluded that Alice Huang was a spy, sources tell me.

How, then, did the media get so spun up over a made-for-Hollywood story about
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang getting honeypotted by a Chinese spy?

Blame Marco Rubio.
